notes: - New in Account: Head camera. On (the default), the picture follows the speaker's head as before. Off, the camera stays still, the way Diary of a CEO and Colin and Samir frame their podcast clips: each camera angle gets one framing for the whole clip with room for the speaker to lean and gesture inside it, the same angle always comes back to the exact same framing, and it only reframes on a cut, never with a pan.
